get_goal.label: Get Goal
get_goal.name: get_goal
get_goal.description: Get the current session goal, including its full objective, status, token usage, and optional budget.

create_goal.label: Create Goal
create_goal.name: create_goal
create_goal.description: Create a goal only when explicitly requested by the user or system instructions. Set a positive token_budget only when a budget is explicitly requested; otherwise omit it or pass null. Fails if a goal already exists; the user must clear it before starting another.

token_budget.description: Positive token budget. Omit or pass null unless explicitly requested.

update_goal.label: Update Goal
update_goal.name: update_goal
update_goal.displaySummary: Complete or block a thread goal
update_goal.description: Mark the session goal complete only when the full objective is verified and no required work remains. Mark it blocked only when the same blocker has recurred for at least three consecutive goal turns and no meaningful progress is possible without user input or an external change. After the user resumes a blocked goal, count those turns from the resume. Difficulty, incomplete work, or a nearly exhausted budget do not justify completion or blocking. Updating a goal does not reply to the user; provide the requested final response afterward.

progress_card.name: progress_card
progress_card.label: Progress Card
progress_card.description: Maintain this session's progress card: the single durable status surface shown next to the session in OpenClaw's UIs, for someone who is not reading the transcript. Create a card only for substantial work with at least two meaningful sequential steps. Do not create a card for greetings, quick questions, or single-step requests, and do not invent steps just to justify one. Existing cards may still be updated or cleared. Each call replaces the whole card. Use either or both parts: `markdown` — for measurable work with a known total, prefer a leading progress bar, e.g. <progress aria-label="PRs reviewed · 12/30" value="12" max="30"></progress>. Use observed completed/total counts for reviews, tests, files, or other work units; prefer these over coarse phase counts. Label what the count measures: reviewed is not merged, and tests finished is not tests passed. Never invent percentages or infer completion from elapsed time. When the total is unknown, use a compact status note or table instead. Follow the bar with a short result, blocker, or next action; use tables for comparisons. The session hovercard pins the bar above the note and shows its aria-label. Other raw HTML is stripped. Known URL? Link it. Don’t leave PRs or issues as bare IDs. And `plan` — an ordered step checklist (pending | in_progress | completed, at most one in_progress) for genuinely sequential work. The checklist is optional: omit it whenever a table, bar, or sentence says it better, and never repeat the same facts in both parts. If no authorized step can proceed because of a pause or external dependency, preserve the unfinished work, blocker, owner, and resume condition in markdown and omit plan; do not mark blocked work completed. Call with both parts empty to clear. Update on meaningful change — a batch completed, a step done, a blocker, results in — not every message. Keep the bar and label current in each replacement. Max 8 KB markdown, 50 steps.

canonicalization.strategy: post-execution generated UUID and timestamp substitution
canonicalization.scope: Only create UUID/create time and update time plus identical occurrences in calls, snapshots and JSON text; original crypto and Date execute unchanged.
canonicalization.checks: UUID v4 format and cross-create uniqueness, safe integer time, created/updated equality, patch/result identity, status timestamp equality and repeated-complete timestamp preservation checked before substitution.
canonicalization.limits: Vectors use independent supplied snapshots. UUID replacements retain per-vector equality and distinctness across create vectors. Timestamp substitution preserves observed intra-vector equality; no cross-vector timing, ordering, duration or real-clock claim.

limits: Complete unchanged Goal factories, goals.ts, goals-transitions.ts, types.ts accounting and common/result helpers execute with actual TypeBox1.3.37.

Session snapshots and successful patch/read callbacks are explicit supplied data boundaries. SQLite/worker actor storage, atomicity, ownership, admissions, event/outbox/watch persistence and publication do not execute; sessions.json is a compatibility address, not a JSON backend.

Progress factory/input/outcome and whole actual gateway protocol schema execute. Gateway facade returns an explicitly supplied successful card; call arguments, receipt, onPlanSaved and private outcome are observed, not real gateway ownership, revision storage, broadcasts or UI rendering.
Full-objective completion, explicit requests and the same blocker for three consecutive goal turns remain description obligations, not semantic runtime proof or blocked-rule enforcement.

Only ordinary positive create/get/update, nonexhausted accounting and root progress markdown/plan/update/clear are invoked. No assembly/root eligibility, child/scheduled admission, continuation, provider accounting, real provider/network or excluded negative/error/cancellation/permission behavior executes.

Routing and schema barrels use declared export aliases to whole pure source modules; unrelated common MIME/filesystem imports are uninvoked throwing boundaries. Every supplied/generated binding and original source is recorded.
This independent reference evidence does not activate Synapsis Goal code or unblock production Concord#107 durable CAS integration.
